points.description: States that the * operator returns an alias (synonym / another name) of an object, rather than a copy of its value.
points.partial_credit: Award partial credit if the answer says it returns the object or value at the pointed-to address but does not mention alias/synonym/another name.

levels.says: Says the * operator returns the object or value stored at the pointed-to address, but does not say alias/synonym/another name.

points.description: Specifies that the object is the one in memory to which the operand (the pointer) points.
points.partial_credit: Award partial credit if the answer mentions that the operand is a pointer/address but does not clearly say the returned alias is of the object pointed to in memory.

levels.says: Mentions that the operand is a pointer or address, but does not clearly connect it to the object whose alias is returned.

points.description: Identifies the * operator as the dereferencing operator.

rubric.notes: Full marks require saying that * returns an alias/synonym of the object pointed to by its operand and that it is the dereferencing operator. Part marks are available for saying it gives the object/value at the pointed-to address without the alias idea, or for mentioning the pointer/address without clearly identifying the pointed-to object. Answers that only say 'pointer' or name an unrelated operator earn no marks.
